product.title: The Classic National Park Tour

description.text: Discover Appalachian history and mountain scenery on a small-group Classic National Park tour from Gatlinburg. Ride in eco-friendly vans to a vanished resort town, learn about Smokies logging and pioneer life, then ascend Newfound Gap Road to the Tennessee–North Carolina divide at 5,000 feet. Stops include scenic overlooks, a light hike, and the site where President Franklin Roosevelt dedicated the park in 1940. Snacks, water, and parking are included for a comfortable half-day introduction to America's most-visited national park.

highlights: Small-group Classic Smoky Mountains tour from Gatlinburg
